newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton Energy oil/gas prices rise.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton Energy oil/gas prices rise.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said Monday its average first-quarter sale prices for oil and natural gas increased to $22.09 per barrel and $2.78 per thousand cubic feet from $17.04 and $1.63, respectively, a year ago.
The company said its first quarter prices were helped by $0.68 per barrel and $0.29 per thousand cubic feet due to hedging transactions established in the fourth quarter.

Average daily production increased to 843 million cubic feet of natural gas equivalents and included 53.9 million cubic feet of natural gas and 5,076 barrels of oil a day. This was up from fourth-quarter 1996 output of 78.1 million cubic feet of natural gas equivalents, including 49.9 million cubic feet of natural gas and 4,693 barrels of oil.
The company drilled 26 wells in the first quarter and completed 25 of them. It plans to drill an initial exploratory well in the Williston Basin in the Montana-North Dakota area.
Hugoton's $50 million drilling budget for 1997 allows for up to 200 wells.
